criticalNotes: Head-of-household 32%/35% breakpoints differ by $25 from single; do not blindly reuse the single table.
Capital-gain rate thresholds apply to stacked taxable income, not to capital gains considered in isolation.

A marginal bracket estimator is not full parity with the competitor tax tool. Further implement self-employment tax, Social Security income taxation, credit eligibility and phaseouts, AMT, NIIT, SALT caps, itemization, qualified business income, and applicable OBBBA deductions.
Income tax liability, W-4 withholding, and paycheck estimation are different models.
Additional Medicare withholding at the employer and final tax liability use different thresholds.
Do not publish state/local tax outputs from a flat guessed rate or national average.
